_comment: GENERATED by tools/build-catalogue.js. Do not edit.
The whole service architecture in one file: services, pipelines,
features and one materialised workflow per feature. This is the file an
automation, a CRM, a quotation generator or an agent reads. No build
reads catalogue/, so nothing here can reach dist/ or a visitor.

summary.en: One consistent look across every channel.
summary.ar: مظهر واحد متسق في كل قناة.

description.en: Logo, identity and visual systems that give your business one consistent look across every channel.
description.ar: شعار وهوية وأنظمة بصرية تمنح عملك مظهرًا واحدًا متسقًا في كل قناة.

stages.objective: Establish what the business is, who it speaks to, and what the identity has to survive.
stages.entry: Signed scope and a completed brand questionnaire.
stages.exit: A written direction the client has agreed to in words, before anything is drawn.

stages.objective: Build the three things everything else is derived from.
stages.entry: Agreed direction.
stages.exit: Logo, colour system and type system approved.

stages.objective: Turn the core into rules other people can follow without asking.
stages.entry: Core identity approved.
stages.exit: Guidelines and visual language documented.

stages.objective: Apply the system to the surfaces the business actually uses.
stages.entry: Core identity approved. Guidelines where the scope includes them.
stages.exit: Every applied item approved at its own revision limit.

stages.objective: Produce original imagery where the identity needs it and stock will not do.
stages.entry: Approved direction. A shot list agreed with the client.
stages.exit: Selected, retouched files delivered.

stages.objective: Hand over files the client owns and can use without us.
stages.entry: Every in-scope item approved.
stages.exit: Archive delivered and receipt confirmed.

summary.en: Designed, built, and handed over working.

description.en: Design, build and deployment — handed over as a working website, with domain and hosting arranged.
description.ar: تصميم وتطوير ونشر — يُسلَّم موقعًا يعمل، مع تجهيز النطاق والاستضافة.

stages.objective: Agree what pages exist, what each is for, and what the site has to do.
stages.entry: Signed scope.
stages.exit: An agreed sitemap and a content list naming who supplies each item.

stages.objective: Secure the address and the place the site will live.
stages.entry: A chosen name, confirmed available, and the client's decision on who holds the account.
stages.exit: Domain registered and hosting provisioned, both in the client's name.

stages.objective: Design every page at every width before any of it is built.
stages.entry: Agreed sitemap. Brand assets, ours or the client's.
stages.exit: Design approved at desktop and phone widths.

stages.objective: Build the approved design as a working site.
stages.entry: Approved design. Final copy and images in hand.
stages.exit: Every page built, responsive, and matching the approved design.

stages.objective: Prove it works before anyone else sees it.
stages.entry: Build complete on a staging address.
stages.exit: Every check passed and recorded.

stages.objective: Put it live and hand over the keys.
stages.entry: Testing passed. Client sign-off on the staging site.
stages.exit: Live on the client's domain, credentials transferred, receipt confirmed.

description.en: Strategy, content and publishing across your channels, with community monitoring and performance analysis.
description.ar: استراتيجية ومحتوى ونشر عبر قنواتك، مع متابعة المجتمع وتحليل الأداء.

pipeline._comment: A MONTHLY LOOP, not a line. Onboarding runs once; plan, produce, publish, engage and report run every month, and the report feeds the next month's plan.

stages.objective: Get access to the accounts and agree the voice.
stages.entry: Signed scope.
stages.exit: Publishing access confirmed on every in-scope platform.

stages.objective: Decide what goes out this month, and why.
stages.entry: Approved voice. Last month's report, from month two onward.
stages.exit: A calendar the client has approved.

stages.objective: Make everything the calendar promised.
stages.entry: Approved calendar. Brand assets and any client-supplied material.
stages.exit: Every item approved at its revision limit and scheduled.

stages.objective: Put it out on time, on the right account.
stages.entry: Approved content, scheduled.
stages.exit: Every scheduled item live, verified on the platform itself.

stages.objective: Answer people, and escalate what we cannot answer.
stages.entry: Published content.
stages.exit: No unanswered message older than the agreed response window.

stages.objective: Say what happened, what caused it, and what changes next month.
stages.entry: A complete calendar month of published activity.
stages.exit: Report sent. Next month's plan carries at least one decision taken from it.

description.en: Paid campaigns across the major platforms, with audience targeting, campaign management, optimization and tracking.
description.ar: حملات مدفوعة على المنصات الرئيسية، مع استهداف الجمهور وإدارة الحملات وتحسينها وتتبع النتائج.

note.en: The advertising budget itself is not included in the management fee. The package price covers managing your campaigns; what you spend with the platforms is separate and paid by you.
note.ar: ميزانية الإعلانات نفسها غير مشمولة في رسوم الإدارة.

pipeline._comment: Setup runs once per campaign. Measure and optimise run continuously; report and review close each month and set the next month's target.

stages.objective: Get into the ad accounts, legitimately and reversibly.
stages.entry: Signed scope.
stages.exit: Partner access granted on every in-scope platform, with the client owning the account.

stages.objective: Decide who we are talking to and what counts as success.
stages.entry: Account access. An agreed objective and a monthly budget figure from the client.
stages.exit: A written target, a defined audience, and a conversion the client agrees to be measured on.

stages.objective: Make the ads.
stages.entry: Approved audience and target. Brand assets.
stages.exit: Copy and creative approved, and compliant with each platform's policy.

stages.objective: Make the result measurable before the money starts moving.
stages.entry: A destination we can put a tag on, and the client's permission to place it.
stages.exit: A test conversion recorded end to end.

stages.objective: Build the campaign and turn it on.
stages.entry: Approved creative. Tracking verified. Budget confirmed in writing.
stages.exit: Campaign live, delivering, and spending at the agreed daily rate.

stages.objective: Improve the result while it runs, without breaking what works.
stages.entry: A live campaign with enough data to read.
stages.exit: Each change recorded with the number that justified it.

stages.objective: Say what the money bought, and what changes next month.
stages.entry: A complete calendar month of spend.
stages.exit: Report sent with spend, result and cost per result, and a decision for next month.

summary.en: All of the above, run as one system.
summary.ar: كل ما سبق، يُدار كنظامٍ واحد.

description.en: The complete connected offering, run as one system from brand through to growth rather than as separate projects.
description.ar: العرض المتكامل بالكامل، يُدار كنظام واحد من العلامة حتى النمو بدل أن يكون مشاريع منفصلة.

_note: THIS SERVICE HAS NO PACKAGES AND NO PRICE, and that is the truth about
it rather than a gap. It is the other four run together, so its price
is whatever the chosen scope is; the brief's instruction is to show
'Custom quote' rather than invent a number, and that is what it does.
Its pipeline is the four services' pipelines in dependency order, not
a sixth set of stages. A composition that had its own hidden workflow
would be a fifth service pretending to be a bundle.

stages.objective: Build the foundation.
stages.entry: Signed scope across the composed services.
stages.exit: Brand core approved — everything downstream depends on it.

stages.objective: Create the digital presence.
stages.entry: Brand core approved.
stages.exit: Site live on the client's domain.

stages.objective: Build ongoing engagement.
stages.entry: Brand core approved. A destination to send people to.
stages.exit: The monthly loop running.

stages.objective: Reach the right audience.
stages.entry: A live destination and measurable conversions.
stages.exit: Campaigns live and reporting monthly.

description.en: A primary mark, drawn for your business, delivered in every format you will need it in.
description.ar: علامة أساسية مصمّمة خصيصًا لعملك، تُسلَّم بكل الصيغ التي ستحتاجها.

purpose.en: The one thing everything else in the identity is built from.
purpose.ar: الأساس الذي تُبنى عليه بقية عناصر الهوية.

inputs: Business name in every language it will appear in
executionSteps: Read the questionnaire and write a one-paragraph direction before drawing.
Sketch and develop distinct concepts — distinct in idea, not in colourway.
Present concepts in context, never as a mark floating on white.
Take the chosen concept through the agreed revision rounds.
Construct the final mark on a grid and build the format set.
qualityChecks: Legible at 16px and at three metres
Works in one colour and reversed out
No effect that fails in print
Name spelled correctly in every language it carries
No resemblance found in a reverse-image and trademark search
features.completionCriteria: Client has approved one mark in writing and the full format set has been delivered and opened.

revisionRules.scope: Refinement of the chosen concept. A new direction restarts the concept stage and is quoted.

description.en: A defined palette — primary, secondary and neutrals — with the values for screen and for print.
description.ar: لوحة ألوان محدَّدة — أساسية وثانوية ومحايدة — بقيمها للشاشة وللطباعة.

purpose.en: So two people designing on different days produce the same colours.
purpose.ar: حتى ينتج شخصان يعملان في يومين مختلفين الألوان نفسها.

inputs: Where the brand will appear — screen, print, signage, or all three
executionSteps: Derive the palette from the approved mark, not from a trend.
Set roles: primary, secondary, neutral, and one state colour if the brand needs it.
Specify HEX, RGB, CMYK and Pantone where print is in scope.
Test every text-on-background pair that the brand will actually use.
outputs: Named palette with roles and values
qualityChecks: Every text pair meets 4.5:1, or is documented as display-only
CMYK conversions checked, not assumed
Palette survives greyscale
features.completionCriteria: Palette approved and every value present for every medium in scope.

description.en: The typefaces the brand uses, the sizes and weights for each role, and — where the brand is bilingual — the Arabic face that pairs with them.
description.ar: الخطوط التي تستخدمها العلامة، ومقاساتها وأوزانها لكل استخدام، والخط العربي المقابل إن كانت العلامة بلغتين.

purpose.en: So headings, body and captions look deliberate rather than picked each time.
purpose.ar: حتى تبدو العناوين والنصوص والتعليقات مقصودة لا مختارة في كل مرة.

inputs: Which languages the brand publishes in
Licence budget, or a constraint to open-licensed faces
executionSteps: Choose a display and a text face that hold up at the sizes actually used.
Where the brand is bilingual, pair an Arabic face by proportion and weight, never by name.
Define a scale with roles rather than a list of sizes.
Confirm the licence covers web, print and handover to the client.
qualityChecks: Arabic and Latin sit on a shared optical baseline at every size
Every weight used is actually available in the licence
Body face legible at 14px on a phone
features.completionCriteria: Scale approved and the licence position confirmed in writing.

description.en: A single sheet holding the mark, the colours and the type — the short version of a guideline.
description.ar: صفحة واحدة تجمع الشعار والألوان والخطوط — النسخة المختصرة من دليل العلامة.

purpose.en: Enough to hand a printer or a freelancer without writing an email.
purpose.ar: تكفي لتسليمها لمطبعة أو مصمم مستقل دون شرح إضافي.

executionSteps: Lay out mark, clear space, palette values and type scale on one sheet.
Export as a PDF that prints correctly at A4.
qualityChecks: Every value on the sheet matches the source files
Prints legibly in one colour
features.completionCriteria: PDF delivered and every value cross-checked against the approved systems.

description.en: A compact document covering the mark, its misuse, the palette, the type and the basic applications.
description.ar: مستند مختصر يغطي الشعار وسوء استخدامه والألوان والخطوط والتطبيقات الأساسية.

purpose.en: So the brand survives being used by someone who was not in the room.
purpose.ar: حتى تبقى العلامة سليمة بيد من لم يشارك في تصميمها.

executionSteps: Document the mark: construction, clear space, minimum size, approved versions.
Show misuse explicitly — the rules people break are the ones worth drawing.
Document palette and type with their values.
Show two or three applications in context.
qualityChecks: Every rule shown as well as stated
No value that disagrees with the source files
Readable on a phone as well as printed
features.completionCriteria: Document delivered and every value cross-checked against the approved systems.
features._supersedes: A short guidelines document contains everything the one-sheet identity card does and then keeps going. Without this, Professional read as having dropped something Starter had — which is how the ladder check found it.

description.en: The full document — mark, system, voice, imagery, layout rules and every application in scope.
description.ar: المستند الكامل — الشعار والنظام ونبرة الصوت والصور وقواعد التنسيق وكل التطبيقات ضمن النطاق.

purpose.en: The version an agency, a printer and a new hire can all work from.
purpose.ar: النسخة التي يمكن أن تعمل بها وكالة ومطبعة وموظف جديد على حد سواء.

executionSteps: Everything in the short guidelines, at full depth.
Add the visual language: imagery, graphic devices, iconography, motion where it exists.
Add layout rules — grid, margins, hierarchy — with worked examples.
Add the applications the project actually produced, in context.
Add a file index naming where every asset lives.
qualityChecks: Every rule shown as well as stated
No value that disagrees with the source files
File index resolves to files that exist in the handover archive
features.completionCriteria: Document delivered, index verified against the handover archive.

description.en: The brand's non-logo vocabulary — graphic devices, imagery direction, iconography and the way things are cropped and composed.
description.ar: مفردات العلامة خارج الشعار — العناصر الجرافيكية واتجاه الصور والأيقونات وطريقة القص والتكوين.

purpose.en: What makes a post recognisable as yours before the logo appears.
purpose.ar: ما يجعل المنشور معروفًا أنه لك قبل أن يظهر الشعار.

executionSteps: Define two or three devices that can be recombined, not a decoration set.
Set an imagery direction with real reference images, and say what is excluded.
Draw an icon set only where the brand will actually use one.
Prove the language on three unrelated layouts.
qualityChecks: Recognisable with the logo removed
Works on a photo and on a flat colour
Holds at a phone's width
features.completionCriteria: Language approved and demonstrated on three layouts.

description.en: Both sides, set up for print.
description.ar: الوجهان، جاهزان للطباعة.

purpose.en: The application people still ask for first.
purpose.ar: التطبيق الذي ما زال يُطلب أولًا.

inputs: Names, titles and contact details as they should be printed, in every language
executionSteps: Lay out both sides at the agreed size.
Set bleed, trim and safe area.
Proof every detail against what the client wrote, not against what it should say.
qualityChecks: 3mm bleed present
No text inside 4mm of trim
Every phone number and address proofread against the client's own written copy
CMYK, not RGB
features.completionCriteria: Print-ready file delivered and the client has confirmed the details are correct.

description.en: A letterhead set up for print and as an editable document.
description.ar: ورق رسمي جاهز للطباعة وكمستند قابل للتحرير.

purpose.en: So an ordinary letter still looks like it came from you.
purpose.ar: حتى يبدو الخطاب العادي صادرًا عنك.

inputs: Registered company details as they must legally appear
executionSteps: Set the sheet with a body area that a typist can actually use.
Produce both a print artwork and an editable document version.
qualityChecks: Body area does not collide with the header at any page length
Editable version keeps the type when opened on a machine without the fonts
features.completionCriteria: Both versions delivered and the editable one opened successfully by the client.

description.en: Profile and cover artwork cut to each platform's own dimensions.
description.ar: صورة الملف والغلاف بمقاسات كل منصة.

purpose.en: So the mark survives a circular crop and a phone-width cover.
purpose.ar: حتى يبقى الشعار سليمًا داخل قص دائري وغلاف بعرض الهاتف.

inputs: The list of platforms in use
executionSteps: Build a profile mark that survives a circular crop at 40px.
Cut covers to each platform's current safe area, not to last year's.
outputs: Profile and cover set per platform
deliverables: PNG per platform, at the platform's stated size
qualityChecks: Nothing important inside the crop on any platform
Mark legible at 40px
Cover checked at phone width, where the safe area is narrowest
features.completionCriteria: Set delivered for every platform in scope and checked live on at least one.

description.en: Individual post designs, made from the brand's own system rather than a template pack.
description.ar: تصاميم منشورات منفردة، مبنية على نظام العلامة لا على قوالب جاهزة.

purpose.en: The unit almost every social plan is counted in.
purpose.ar: الوحدة التي تُحسب بها معظم خطط التواصل.

features._addonName: THE PUBLISHED ADD-ON WORDING, kept exactly as it shipped. An add-on names the UNIT YOU BUY, which is not always the capability's own name — you buy 'a single social media post design', the capability is 'social media post design'. Preserving these verbatim is also what makes this change provably display-neutral: the generated add-ons section is byte-for-byte the hand-typed one it replaces, except for the single defect it fixes.
inputs: Approved brand assets, ours or the client's
executionSteps: Set each post from the brand's type scale and palette.
Check the crop at the platform's feed ratio before exporting.
Export at the platform's stated size, not scaled up.
deliverables: PNG or JPG at platform size
qualityChecks: Text legible at feed size on a phone
Nothing important inside the platform's overlay areas
Arabic set right-to-left with correct shaping where present
features.completionCriteria: Every ordered post approved and exported.

description.en: A reusable set of post layouts — not finished posts, but the frames the posts are made in.
description.ar: مجموعة تخطيطات قابلة لإعادة الاستخدام — ليست منشورات جاهزة، بل الإطارات التي تُصنع فيها.

purpose.en: So a month of posts takes hours rather than days, and still looks like one brand.
purpose.ar: حتى يستغرق شهر من المنشورات ساعات لا أيامًا، ويبقى بمظهر علامة واحدة.

inputs: Approved visual language where in scope
The post types the client actually publishes
executionSteps: Identify the recurring post types rather than inventing categories.
Build one layout per type, with the variable parts marked.
Prove each layout with three different lengths of real copy.
outputs: Layout set with variable regions marked
qualityChecks: Every layout survives copy at three lengths
Every layout works in both languages where the brand is bilingual
No layout that only works with the example image
features.completionCriteria: Layout set approved and demonstrated with real copy.

description.en: A small set of ad frames in the sizes the main platforms require.
description.ar: مجموعة صغيرة من الإطارات الإعلانية بالمقاسات التي تطلبها المنصات الرئيسية.

purpose.en: So an ad can be produced without redesigning it each time.
purpose.ar: حتى يُنتَج الإعلان دون إعادة تصميمه في كل مرة.

inputs: The platforms and placements in use
executionSteps: Build one frame per required ratio.
Mark the variable regions.
Check each against the platform's text and safe-area rules.
qualityChecks: Every ratio the client's platforms require is present
Nothing important inside a platform's overlay area
features.completionCriteria: Frame set approved and one ad produced from it successfully.

description.en: The full frame set — every placement, both languages, with the variable regions defined.
description.ar: مجموعة الإطارات الكاملة — كل المواضع، بلغتين، مع تحديد المناطق المتغيرة.

purpose.en: So a campaign can be built out across placements in an afternoon.
purpose.ar: حتى تُبنى الحملة عبر كل المواضع في فترة واحدة.

inputs: Approved visual language where in scope
executionSteps: Build the frame set across every placement in scope.
Produce each in both languages where the brand is bilingual.
Mark variable regions and state the character limits that keep them working.
qualityChecks: Every placement present
Arabic version is laid out right-to-left, not mirrored mechanically
Character limits tested at the limit
features.completionCriteria: Frame set approved and proven on one real campaign's copy.

description.en: A deck template with the layouts a real presentation needs, editable by the client.
description.ar: قالب عرض يضم التخطيطات التي يحتاجها عرض حقيقي، قابل للتحرير من العميل.

purpose.en: So an internal deck stops undoing the identity.
purpose.ar: حتى يتوقف العرض الداخلي عن نقض الهوية.

inputs: Which software the client actually presents in
executionSteps: Build the layouts a deck actually uses — title, section, text, two-column, image, data, closing.
Set them as real master slides, not as pasted artwork.
Embed or substitute the fonts so it survives the client's machine.
qualityChecks: Masters are editable, not flattened images
Opens correctly on a machine without the brand fonts
Works at 16:9 and 4:3 if the client uses both
features.completionCriteria: Template delivered and the client has built one slide from it.

description.en: A finished deck, designed slide by slide from your content.
description.ar: عرض تقديمي مكتمل، مصمَّم شريحة بشريحة من محتواك.

purpose.en: For the deck that has to win something.
purpose.ar: للعرض الذي يجب أن يكسب شيئًا.

features._addonName: THE PUBLISHED ADD-ON WORDING, kept exactly as it shipped. An add-on names the UNIT YOU BUY, which is not always the capability's own name — you buy 'a single social media post design', the capability is 'social media post design'. Preserving these verbatim is also what makes this change provably display-neutral: the generated add-ons section is byte-for-byte the hand-typed one it replaces, except for the single defect it fixes.
inputs: Approved brand assets, ours or the client's
executionSteps: Read the content and restructure it before designing it.
Design each slide to one idea.
Rebuild data as designed charts rather than pasted screenshots.
qualityChecks: Every slide readable from the back of a room
No pasted screenshot standing in for a chart
Numbers on charts checked against the client's own source
features.completionCriteria: Deck approved and delivered in both formats.

revisionRules.scope: Design revisions. Content changes after approval are quoted.

description.en: A company profile layout the client can refill as the business changes.
description.ar: تخطيط ملف تعريفي يمكن للعميل إعادة تعبئته كلما تغيّر العمل.

purpose.en: So next year's profile does not need us.
purpose.ar: حتى لا يحتاج ملف العام القادم إلينا.

inputs: The sections the client's profile actually contains
executionSteps: Build one layout per recurring section.
Mark the variable regions and state their limits.
Deliver in software the client owns.
qualityChecks: Every section type present
Survives sections of different lengths
Editable on the client's own software
features.completionCriteria: Template delivered and the client has refilled one section successfully.

description.en: A finished company profile — written where you need it written, designed and print-ready.
description.ar: ملف تعريفي مكتمل — يُكتب عند الحاجة، ويُصمَّم ويُجهَّز للطباعة.

purpose.en: The document a tender or a bank asks for.
purpose.ar: المستند الذي تطلبه المناقصة أو البنك.

features._addonName: THE PUBLISHED ADD-ON WORDING, kept exactly as it shipped. An add-on names the UNIT YOU BUY, which is not always the capability's own name — you buy 'a single social media post design', the capability is 'social media post design'. Preserving these verbatim is also what makes this change provably display-neutral: the generated add-ons section is byte-for-byte the hand-typed one it replaces, except for the single defect it fixes.
inputs: Whether we write the content or the client supplies it
executionSteps: Agree the section list before writing or designing anything.
Write or edit the content.
Design the pages.
Prepare a print-ready file and a screen file separately.
qualityChecks: Every claim in the text traceable to something the client supplied
Print file carries bleed and CMYK
Screen file under 10MB and readable on a phone
features.completionCriteria: Both files delivered and the client has confirmed every factual detail.

revisionRules.scope: Design and copy revisions within the agreed section list.

description.en: Editable layouts the client fills in themselves, in software they already have.
description.ar: تخطيطات قابلة للتحرير يملؤها العميل بنفسه، ببرامج يملكها فعلًا.

purpose.en: So routine content stops being a request.
purpose.ar: حتى يتوقف المحتوى الروتيني عن كونه طلبًا.

inputs: Which software the client's team can actually use
executionSteps: Agree which content types recur often enough to be worth a template.
Build each with the editable regions locked apart from the fixed ones.
Write a one-page instruction that assumes no design knowledge.
qualityChecks: A non-designer can produce a correct item from each template unaided
Fixed regions cannot be edited by accident
features.completionCriteria: Templates delivered and the client has produced one item from one of them without help.

description.en: A shoot, on location, with selection and retouching.
description.ar: جلسة تصوير في الموقع، مع الاختيار والمعالجة.

purpose.en: So the brand shows its own work instead of stock.
purpose.ar: حتى تعرض العلامة عملها الحقيقي بدل الصور الجاهزة.

inputs: A shot list agreed in advance
Access, permits and any people appearing
executionSteps: Agree the shot list and the number of final images before the day.
Shoot to the list, then shoot beyond it.
Select, then retouch only the selected.
Deliver at print and screen resolutions.
qualityChecks: Every item on the agreed shot list covered
Colour consistent across the set
Written permission held for every identifiable person
features.completionCriteria: The agreed number of final images delivered and receipt confirmed.

revisionRules.scope: Retouching of selected images. A reshoot is a new booking.

quoteReason.en: Priced by location, day count and the number of final images.
quoteReason.ar: يُسعَّر حسب الموقع وعدد الأيام وعدد الصور النهائية.

description.en: A shoot for video, with the footage delivered ready to edit.
description.ar: تصوير فيديو، مع تسليم اللقطات جاهزة للمونتاج.

purpose.en: The footage everything else is cut from.
purpose.ar: اللقطات التي يُبنى منها كل ما بعدها.

inputs: Access, permits and any people appearing
executionSteps: Agree the treatment and the deliverable lengths before the day.
Shoot with sound captured separately where dialogue is involved.
Back up on site, twice, before leaving.
Deliver organised, labelled footage.
qualityChecks: Two backups made before leaving the location
Audio checked on headphones during the shoot, not after
Every item on the treatment covered
features.completionCriteria: Footage delivered, logged, and confirmed openable by whoever edits it.

revisionRules.scope: A reshoot is a new booking.

quoteReason.en: Priced by location, day count, crew and the deliverables cut from it.
quoteReason.ar: يُسعَّر حسب الموقع وعدد الأيام وفريق العمل والمخرجات المطلوبة.

description.en: The exported files you need to use the identity, without the editable sources.
description.ar: الملفات المصدَّرة اللازمة لاستخدام الهوية، دون الملفات القابلة للتحرير.

purpose.en: Enough to hand to a printer or upload anywhere.
purpose.ar: تكفي لتسليمها لمطبعة أو رفعها في أي مكان.

executionSteps: Export every approved item in the agreed formats.
Name files so a stranger can find one.
Deliver as a single archive.
qualityChecks: Every file opens
No file named 'final-2'
Archive downloaded and opened once by us before it is sent
features.completionCriteria: Archive delivered and the client has confirmed it opened.

revisionRules.scope: Missing files are supplied, not revised.

description.en: The exports plus the editable sources everything was made in.
description.ar: الملفات المصدَّرة مع الملفات المصدرية القابلة للتحرير.

purpose.en: So another designer can continue the work without redrawing it.
purpose.ar: حتى يتمكن مصمم آخر من إكمال العمل دون إعادة رسمه.

executionSteps: Everything in the basic export set.
Add the editable sources, with layers named.
Add font licences or links.
Deliver as a single structured archive.
qualityChecks: Every source opens on a machine that is not ours
Layers named
Fonts either embedded, licensed to the client, or replaced with ones that are
features.completionCriteria: Archive delivered and one source file opened successfully by the client.

revisionRules.scope: Missing files are supplied, not revised.

description.en: The whole archive — every item, every format, every source, indexed.
description.ar: الأرشيف بالكامل — كل عنصر وكل صيغة وكل ملف مصدري، مفهرسة.

purpose.en: So the brand is genuinely yours the day the project ends.
purpose.ar: حتى تصبح العلامة ملكك فعلًا يوم انتهاء المشروع.

inputs: The guidelines document where in scope
executionSteps: Everything in the source set.
Add photography, templates and any produced content.
Write an index naming what each folder holds.
Verify the index against the archive, file by file.
qualityChecks: Index resolves to files that exist
Archive downloaded and opened once by us before it is sent
Nothing in it references a file we did not deliver
features.completionCriteria: Archive delivered, index verified, and the client has confirmed receipt.

revisionRules.scope: Missing files are supplied, not revised.

description.en: Running your advertising account on each platform in scope.
description.ar: تشغيل حسابك الإعلاني على كل منصة ضمن النطاق.

purpose.en: The unit an advertising package is sized by.
purpose.ar: الوحدة التي تُقاس بها الباقة الإعلانية.

features._options: PLATFORMS ARE SCOPE, NOT A NUMBER. The quantity is derived from the platforms chosen rather than typed, so a scope records Google Ads and Meta Ads rather than "2" — which is the difference between something a quotation or an agent can act on and something it has to guess at. The list lives in platforms.json and is extensible: adding one is an entry there, and it appears in the chooser in both languages with no code change.
inputs: Partner access to the client's ad account
A billing method on the client's account
executionSteps: Take partner access, never account ownership.
Confirm billing sits on the client's own method.
Keep each platform's account structure legible to someone who inherits it.
outputs: A managed ad account per platform
qualityChecks: Client owns every account
Billing on the client's method
Naming convention consistent enough to read a year later
features.completionCriteria: The month's campaigns delivered on every platform in scope.

description.en: Building the campaign — objective, structure, audiences, placements, budget and schedule.
description.ar: بناء الحملة — الهدف والهيكل والجماهير والمواضع والميزانية والجدولة.

purpose.en: Everything a campaign does afterwards depends on how it was built.
purpose.ar: كل ما تفعله الحملة لاحقًا يعتمد على طريقة بنائها.

executionSteps: Choose the objective that matches the result being paid for, not the one that reports the best numbers.
Build the structure so each variable can be read separately later.
Set budgets and a schedule the client has confirmed in writing.
Review every ad against the platform's policy before submitting.
deliverables: Built campaigns, ad sets and ads
qualityChecks: Objective matches the agreed result
Budget matches the written confirmation, to the currency
Every destination link opens the right page and carries its tracking
No ad approved that breaks a platform policy
features.completionCriteria: Campaign live, delivering, and spending at the agreed daily rate.

revisionRules.scope: Restructuring an approved campaign is optimisation, not revision.

description.en: What we are trying to make happen, for whom, at what cost per result.
description.ar: ما الذي نريد تحقيقه، ولمن، وبأي تكلفة لكل نتيجة.

purpose.en: So spending can be judged rather than defended.
purpose.ar: حتى يُحكم على الإنفاق بدل تبريره.

executionSteps: Establish what a customer is worth before deciding what a click may cost.
Set a target cost per result and say what happens if it is not met.
Choose platforms by where the audience is, not by where the budget is easiest to spend.
Write the plan down and have the client agree the target in writing.
deliverables: Strategy document with target cost per result and a stop condition
qualityChecks: A target the client agreed to be measured against
A stated stop condition, so a failing campaign has an ending
No projected figure presented as a promise
features.completionCriteria: Client has agreed the target and the stop condition in writing.

description.en: Deciding who the advertising goes to, and how far we go to find out.
description.ar: تحديد من تصل إليه الإعلانات، وإلى أي مدى نبحث لمعرفة ذلك.

purpose.en: The first and cheapest lever on what an ad costs.
purpose.ar: أول وأرخص عامل يؤثر في تكلفة الإعلان.

inputs: Who the client believes their customer is
Any customer list the client may lawfully use
Past campaign or site analytics, from the research level up
Enough budget per segment to reach significance, at the segmentation level
executionSteps: Write the audience in words before building it in a tool.
Build it on the platform and check its size is neither absurd nor empty.
Exclude existing customers where paying to reach them again is waste.
At the research level: read what past campaigns and site analytics already show, and what competitors are running, before proposing anything new.
At the segmentation level: split only where the message genuinely differs, and build exclusions so segments do not bid against each other.
outputs: A defined audience, at the depth bought
deliverables: Saved audiences with a written definition each
Findings document, from the research level up
A per-segment budget split, at the segmentation level
qualityChecks: Audience size plausible for the budget
Exclusions applied
Any uploaded list carries consent the client can evidence
Every finding traceable to a source, not to an impression
Segments mutually exclusive and each large enough to produce a readable result
features.completionCriteria: Audience built, sized and approved before the campaign goes live, at the depth the scope bought.

_comment: DEPTH, NOT THREE FEATURES. The owner's rule of 8 September applied here by
the ladder check rather than by hand: these were three ids for one decision —
who the advertising goes to — and a package that bought the deep one read as
having dropped the shallow one.

description.en: Building the audience from what the business already knows about its customers.
description.ar: بناء الجمهور مما يعرفه العمل عن عملائه أصلًا.

scope: Audience written in words, then built in the tool

description.en: Finding out who actually responds rather than assuming who should, then targeting that.
description.ar: معرفة من يستجيب فعلًا بدل افتراض من ينبغي أن يستجيب، ثم استهدافه.

scope: Past campaign and site analytics read
Competitor advertising read in the platforms’ public libraries
A prioritised list of audiences worth testing

description.en: Splitting the researched audience into groups that get different messages and separate budgets.
description.ar: تقسيم الجمهور المدروس إلى مجموعات تتلقى رسائل مختلفة وميزانيات منفصلة.

scope: Mutually exclusive segments, each large enough to read

features._sharesMethodWith: The same method as feat.social.audience_research at the research level, applied to paid rather than organic. Two features, two services, two pipelines — but findings from either should be reused rather than re-bought.

description.en: The headlines, body text and calls to action, written for each placement's limits.
description.ar: العناوين والنصوص وعبارات الحث، مكتوبة وفق حدود كل موضع.

purpose.en: The line that gets the click.
purpose.ar: الجملة التي تحقق النقرة.

inputs: The offer, exactly as it may lawfully be stated
executionSteps: Write several distinct angles, not several rewordings of one.
Write Arabic natively where the audience reads Arabic.
Stay inside each placement's limits at the limit, not at the average.
Check every claim against the platform's advertising policy before submitting.
deliverables: Copy variants per placement, per language
qualityChecks: Every claim substantiated by something the client supplied
Within each placement's limit
No prohibited claim under the platform's policy
Arabic written natively, not translated
features.completionCriteria: Copy approved by the client and accepted by the platform.

description.en: The image or video for each ad, built to the placement's own size and rules.
description.ar: الصورة أو الفيديو لكل إعلان، بمقاس الموضع وقواعده.

purpose.en: What the money is actually buying attention for.
purpose.ar: ما يشتري المال الانتباه له فعلًا.

executionSteps: Design from the brand's ad frames where they exist.
Produce every ratio the chosen placements require.
Keep the message readable at feed size before anything else.
Check each against the platform's creative policy.
deliverables: Artwork or video at each required size
qualityChecks: Readable at feed size on a phone
Every required ratio present
Nothing important under a platform overlay
Passes the platform's creative policy
features.completionCriteria: Every ordered creative approved and accepted by the platform.

description.en: Installing and verifying the measurement that says whether an ad produced a result.
description.ar: تركيب وتوثيق القياس الذي يحدد ما إذا كان الإعلان قد حقق نتيجة.

purpose.en: Without this, every other number is traffic, not results.
purpose.ar: بدون هذا، تبقى كل الأرقام زيارات لا نتائج.

inputs: A destination we can place a tag on
A definition of what counts as a conversion
executionSteps: Agree what counts as a conversion, in one sentence, before installing anything.
Install the platform's tag and define the event.
Complete the action yourself and confirm it arrives.
Set up server-side or enhanced matching where the platform supports it and the client consents.
qualityChecks: A real test conversion seen end to end, not a tag that merely fires
No double counting
Consent handling in place where the audience is covered by it
features.completionCriteria: A test conversion visible in the platform's own reporting.

description.en: Advertising again to people who already visited or engaged.
description.ar: إعادة الإعلان لمن سبق أن زار أو تفاعل.

purpose.en: Usually the cheapest result in the account.
purpose.ar: عادةً أرخص نتيجة في الحساب.

inputs: Enough traffic to build an audience
A different message for people who already know you
executionSteps: Build the audience from the tracked events, and wait until it is large enough to serve.
Write a message for someone who has already seen the first one.
Cap frequency — retargeting is the campaign that most easily becomes harassment.
Exclude people who already converted.
qualityChecks: Converters excluded
Frequency capped
Audience large enough to deliver
Creative differs from the prospecting campaign
features.completionCriteria: Campaign live, delivering, with converters excluded and frequency capped.

description.en: Watching delivery and spend so a problem is caught in hours, not at month end.
description.ar: متابعة الأداء والإنفاق حتى تُكتشف المشكلة خلال ساعات لا في نهاية الشهر.

purpose.en: A campaign that stopped delivering costs you the whole week silently.
purpose.ar: الحملة التي تتوقف عن العمل تكلّفك الأسبوع كله بصمت.

inputs: The agreed target and stop condition
executionSteps: Check delivery, spend rate and cost per result on the agreed schedule.
Flag anything outside the agreed band the day it happens.
Check ad status — a disapproved ad reports as spending nothing, not as an error.
qualityChecks: No day of zero delivery unexplained
Spend within the agreed daily band
No disapproved ad left sitting
features.completionCriteria: The month closes with every delivery interruption explained and dated.
features._selectable: NOT A CHOICE. It costs nothing and nobody running paid advertising declines to watch it. Sold as a tickable row it let a scope buy optimisation with nothing watching the campaign, and it made ads-growth read as having dropped something ads-starter had.

description.en: Improving the result while it runs — audiences, placements, bids, creative and budget — on the evidence, one change at a time.
description.ar: تحسين النتيجة أثناء التشغيل — الجماهير والمواضع والمزايدات والتصاميم والميزانية — بناءً على الأدلة، بتغيير واحد في كل مرة.

purpose.en: The part of the fee that pays for itself, or does not.
purpose.ar: الجزء من الرسوم الذي يغطي نفسه، أو لا يغطيها.

inputs: A live campaign with enough data to read
executionSteps: Wait for enough data before changing anything — most optimisation is reading noise.
Change one variable at a time, and write down the number that justified it.
Turn off what is losing before adding what might win.
Leave the winning ad set alone.
At the full level: track cost per result per creative and rotate on the trend, and reallocate budget inside the agreed total without ever exceeding it.
outputs: A lower cost per result, or a documented reason it did not fall
deliverables: A change log with the figure behind each change
A before-and-after figure per budget move, at the full level
qualityChecks: No change made on fewer results than the platform's own learning threshold
One variable at a time
Every change recorded with its justification
The winner left running
No creative left running past its measured fatigue point
The monthly total never exceeded
features.completionCriteria: The month closes with a change log and a stated direction for the next.

_comment: DEPTH, NOT THREE FEATURES. The owner's rule of 8 September applied here by
the ladder check rather than by hand: these were three ids for one decision —
who the advertising goes to — and a package that bought the deep one read as
having dropped the shallow one.

description.en: Pausing what loses and leaving what wins alone.
description.ar: إيقاف ما يخسر وترك ما ينجح يعمل.

scope: Each change recorded with its figure

description.en: Adjusting audiences, placements, bids and structure to bring the cost per result down.
description.ar: تعديل الجماهير والمواضع والمزايدات والهيكل لخفض تكلفة النتيجة.

scope: Structural changes where the data supports them

description.en: Everything above, plus rotating creative before it tires and moving budget towards what is working, inside the total you set.
description.ar: كل ما سبق، مع تدوير التصاميم قبل استهلاكها ونقل الميزانية نحو ما ينجح ضمن الإجمالي الذي حددته.

scope: Cost per result tracked per creative, and creative rotated on the trend rather than on a schedule
Budget reallocated inside the agreed total, in steps small enough not to reset learning
A before-and-after figure recorded for every move

description.en: Running two versions against each other properly, so the result means something.
description.ar: تشغيل نسختين إحداهما مقابل الأخرى بشكل صحيح، حتى تعني النتيجة شيئًا.

purpose.en: So a decision rests on a measurement rather than on a preference.
purpose.ar: حتى يقوم القرار على قياس لا على تفضيل.

inputs: Two versions differing in one thing
Budget enough for each arm to reach significance
executionSteps: Write the hypothesis and the winning condition before starting.
Change one variable. A test of two different ads tells you nothing about why.
Use the platform's own split-test tool so the audiences do not overlap.
Run to the stated sample, then stop — reading it early is how a coin flip becomes a strategy.
deliverables: Test record with hypothesis, arms, sample and outcome
qualityChecks: Exactly one variable differs
Audiences do not overlap
Run to the stated sample before being read
An inconclusive result recorded as inconclusive, not as a preference
features.completionCriteria: Test concluded at the stated sample and the outcome applied or explicitly rejected.

description.en: Spend, results, cost per result, and what changes next month.
description.ar: الإنفاق والنتائج وتكلفة النتيجة، وما الذي سيتغير الشهر القادم.

purpose.en: The only honest way to judge whether the advertising is worth doing.
purpose.ar: الطريقة الوحيدة الصادقة للحكم على جدوى الإعلان.

inputs: A complete calendar month of spend
executionSteps: Report spend, results and cost per result — in that order, because that is the order they matter.
Compare against the agreed target, including when the comparison is unflattering.
Say what changed during the month and what it did.
End with the decision for next month.
qualityChecks: Every figure traceable to a platform screen
The target stated and the result compared to it, whichever way it went
Spend reconciles with the client's own platform invoice
At least one decision stated for next month
features.completionCriteria: Report sent within the agreed window and reconciled against the platform invoice.

description.en: A call to read the month together and set the next one's target.
description.ar: مكالمة لقراءة الشهر معًا وتحديد هدف الشهر التالي.

purpose.en: Because the decision that matters is usually not one we can make alone.
purpose.ar: لأن القرار المهم عادةً لا نستطيع اتخاذه وحدنا.

inputs: The client's own sales figures where they will share them
executionSteps: Send the report first.
Open with the decision, not the dashboard.
Agree next month's target and budget in the call.
Write it down and send it the same day.
outputs: An agreed target and budget for the coming month
deliverables: A written note of what was agreed
qualityChecks: Report sent at least a day before
Next month's budget confirmed in writing
Note sent the same day
features.completionCriteria: Target and budget agreed in writing before the new month starts.

description.en: Creating or repairing the accounts, filling out every profile field, and getting publishing access.
description.ar: إنشاء الحسابات أو إصلاحها، وتعبئة كل حقول الملف، والحصول على صلاحية النشر.

purpose.en: Half of a weak presence is an unfinished profile.
purpose.ar: نصف ضعف الحضور سببه ملف غير مكتمل.

inputs: Existing account access, or the decision to create new ones
executionSteps: Audit what already exists before creating anything — duplicate accounts are worse than none.
Create or claim, with the client as owner and us as a manager.
Fill every profile field, including the ones nobody fills.
Enable two-factor authentication on the client's own device.
outputs: Accounts the client owns and we can publish to
qualityChecks: Client is the owner on every account
Two-factor on, with the client holding the second factor
No duplicate or orphaned account left live
features.completionCriteria: A test post published and removed on every in-scope platform.
features._selectable: NOT A CHOICE. It costs nothing, it cannot be skipped, and three packages carry it without itemising it — which is why build-catalogue.js used to report them as promising publishing with no account behind it.

description.en: Running the account day to day on each platform in scope.
description.ar: تشغيل الحساب يوميًا على كل منصة ضمن النطاق.

purpose.en: The unit a social package is actually sized by.
purpose.ar: الوحدة التي تُقاس بها باقة التواصل فعليًا.

features._options: PLATFORMS ARE SCOPE, NOT A NUMBER. The quantity is derived from the platforms chosen rather than typed, so a scope records Google Ads and Meta Ads rather than "2" — which is the difference between something a quotation or an agent can act on and something it has to guess at. The list lives in platforms.json and is extensible: adding one is an entry there, and it appears in the chooser in both languages with no code change.
executionSteps: Keep each platform's profile current.
Adapt each month's content to each platform rather than cross-posting one file.
Watch each platform's own changes and say when one affects the plan.
deliverables: An active, current account per platform
qualityChecks: No platform left without a post for longer than the plan allows
Nothing cross-posted at the wrong ratio
features.completionCriteria: The month's plan delivered on every platform in scope.

description.en: What goes out, on which platform, on which day — agreed before the month starts.
description.ar: ما يُنشر وعلى أي منصة وفي أي يوم — يُتفق عليه قبل بدء الشهر.

purpose.en: So nobody is writing a post on the morning it goes out.
purpose.ar: حتى لا يُكتب المنشور صباح يوم نشره.

inputs: Client dates that must be covered
Last month's report, from month two
executionSteps: Start from the client's own calendar — launches, seasons, holidays.
Assign a purpose to every slot, not just a topic.
Send it for approval before anything is produced.
deliverables: The calendar, in a form the client can comment on
qualityChecks: Post count matches the package
Every client-supplied date covered
No slot without a stated purpose
features.completionCriteria: Client has approved the calendar before production starts.
features._selectable: NOT A CHOICE EITHER. Every social package publishes on a schedule, so every social package has a calendar; Growth and Pro simply never itemised one. It is included in platform management rather than sold beside it.

description.en: Who we are talking to, what we say, in what proportions, and how we will know it worked.
description.ar: لمن نتحدث، وماذا نقول، وبأي نسب، وكيف نعرف أنه نجح.

purpose.en: So the calendar has a reason and not just a rhythm.
purpose.ar: حتى يكون للتقويم سبب لا إيقاع فقط.

_comment: DEPTH, NOT A SECOND FEATURE. The owner's instruction on 8 September was
explicit: where the underlying capability is shared, keep ONE canonical
feature and differentiate it by scope. Content strategy at Growth and at
Pro is the same work done to a different depth, and publishing it twice
would give an automation two ids for one thing.
`priceFactor` multiplies pricing.from; `effortFactor` multiplies
estimatedEffort. A package row selects a level with `tier`; the builder
offers the levels as a choice on the row rather than as two rows.

description.en: Pillars with a proportion each, a tone written in examples, and one target the platform actually reports.
description.ar: محاور بنِسَب محددة، ونبرة مكتوبة بأمثلة، وهدف واحد تقيسه المنصة فعلًا.

scope: Tone examples in every language published

description.en: Everything in the core strategy, plus a competitor read, a channel-by-channel plan and a quarterly revision built from the reports.
description.ar: كل ما في الاستراتيجية الأساسية، مع قراءة للمنافسين وخطة لكل قناة على حدة ومراجعة ربعية مبنية على التقارير.

scope: A plan per channel rather than one for all of them
Quarterly revision driven by the reports

executionSteps: Read the existing account before proposing anything.
Define pillars with a proportion each, so the mix is decidable rather than argued monthly.
Set a target that can be measured with a number the platform actually reports.
Write the tone in examples, not adjectives.
deliverables: Strategy document with pillars, proportions, tone examples and a target
qualityChecks: Every pillar has a proportion
The target is a number the platform reports
Tone shown with real example sentences in both languages where the brand is bilingual
features.completionCriteria: Client has approved the strategy and the first calendar is built from it.

description.en: The words for each post, written in the brand's voice, in the languages you publish in.
description.ar: نصوص كل منشور، بصوت العلامة، وباللغات التي تنشر بها.

purpose.en: The half of a post that people actually read.
purpose.ar: النصف الذي يقرأه الناس فعلًا من المنشور.

features._addonName: THE PUBLISHED ADD-ON WORDING, kept exactly as it shipped. An add-on names the UNIT YOU BUY, which is not always the capability's own name — you buy 'a single social media post design', the capability is 'social media post design'. Preserving these verbatim is also what makes this change provably display-neutral: the generated add-ons section is byte-for-byte the hand-typed one it replaces, except for the single defect it fixes.
inputs: Any product or offer detail that must be accurate
executionSteps: Write to the slot's stated purpose, not to a word count.
Write Arabic as Arabic, never as a translation of the English draft.
Check every factual claim against something the client supplied.
Leave the call to action explicit.
deliverables: Copy in every language in scope, per post
qualityChecks: No claim that cannot be traced to something the client wrote
Arabic reads as written, not translated
Within each platform's own limit
Prices, dates and phone numbers proofread against the source
features.completionCriteria: Copy approved for every post in the month's calendar.

description.en: The visual for each post, made in the brand's system.
description.ar: العنصر البصري لكل منشور، ضمن نظام العلامة.

purpose.en: What stops the scroll.
purpose.ar: ما يوقف التمرير.

executionSteps: Design from the brand's layouts where they exist.
Set the copy in the design, at its real length.
Export at each platform's stated size.
deliverables: Artwork at platform size, per post, per platform
qualityChecks: Legible at feed size on a phone
Nothing important under a platform overlay
Arabic shaped and laid out right-to-left
features.completionCriteria: Artwork approved for every post in the month's calendar.

features._latinName: The platform's own product name. It is written Reels in Arabic too, on this site and everywhere else, so the two labels are identical on purpose rather than by an untranslated oversight.

description.en: Short vertical video, cut and captioned for the feed.
description.ar: فيديو رأسي قصير، يُقصّ وتُضاف إليه النصوص المصاحبة للعرض في التغذية.

purpose.en: The format the platforms currently reward most.
purpose.ar: الصيغة التي تكافئها المنصات أكثر حاليًا.

features._addonName: THE PUBLISHED ADD-ON WORDING, kept exactly as it shipped. An add-on names the UNIT YOU BUY, which is not always the capability's own name — you buy 'a single social media post design', the capability is 'social media post design'. inputs: Music with a licence that covers commercial use
executionSteps: Write the first three seconds before cutting anything else.
Cut vertical, at the platform's own ratio.
Burn in captions — most of the audience watches with sound off.
Use only music the client is licensed to use commercially.
qualityChecks: Readable with sound off
Nothing important inside the platform's UI overlay
Music licence confirmed, not assumed
Arabic captions shaped and right-to-left
features.completionCriteria: Every ordered reel approved and scheduled.

description.en: Daily short-lived posts — the account's pulse between the planned posts.
description.ar: منشورات يومية قصيرة العمر — نبض الحساب بين المنشورات المجدولة.

purpose.en: What makes an account look alive rather than scheduled.
purpose.ar: ما يجعل الحساب يبدو حيًا لا مجدولًا.

inputs: Whatever the client is actually doing this week
executionSteps: Agree a weekly rhythm rather than a story count.
Produce to the brand's story frames.
Use the platform's own features — polls, questions — where they earn a reply.
qualityChecks: Nothing important under the platform's own UI
Links working where used
Highlights covers consistent
features.completionCriteria: The agreed weekly rhythm maintained for the month.

revisionRules.scope: Stories expire; corrections are republished, not revised.

description.en: Editing supplied or shot footage into a finished piece, with captions and grading.
description.ar: تحرير اللقطات المصوَّرة أو المسلَّمة إلى مادة نهائية، مع النصوص المصاحبة والتدرّج اللوني.

purpose.en: For video longer or more considered than a reel.
purpose.ar: للفيديو الأطول أو الأكثر إعدادًا من الريل.

features._addonName: THE PUBLISHED ADD-ON WORDING, kept exactly as it shipped. An add-on names the UNIT YOU BUY, which is not always the capability's own name — you buy 'a single social media post design', the capability is 'social media post design'. Preserving these verbatim is also what makes this change provably display-neutral: the generated add-ons section is byte-for-byte the hand-typed one it replaces, except for the single defect it fixes.
executionSteps: Assemble to the structure before touching the grade.
Show a rough cut for approval before finishing.
Grade, mix and caption.
Export per destination, not once.
qualityChecks: Audio levels consistent across the whole piece
Captions accurate, and shaped correctly in Arabic
Music licence confirmed
Exports checked on a phone, not only on the editing monitor
features.completionCriteria: Final approved and every export delivered.

revisionRules.scope: One at rough cut, one after. Changes after the final are quoted.

description.en: Scheduling every approved item and confirming it actually went out.
description.ar: جدولة كل عنصر معتمد والتأكد من نشره فعليًا.

purpose.en: A scheduled post that silently failed is the same as no post.
purpose.ar: المنشور المجدول الذي فشل صامتًا كأنه لم يُنشر.

executionSteps: Schedule to the approved calendar.
Check each item's preview on the platform before it goes.
Verify publication on the platform itself, not in the scheduler's status column.
Republish anything that failed, the same day.
deliverables: A published month matching the approved calendar
qualityChecks: Every scheduled item verified live on the platform
Nothing published to the wrong account
Failures caught the same day, not at the monthly report
features.completionCriteria: Every item in the month's calendar confirmed live.

description.en: Watching comments and messages, answering the routine ones and escalating the rest.
description.ar: متابعة التعليقات والرسائل، والرد على المعتاد منها وتصعيد ما عداه.

purpose.en: So a question does not sit unanswered for a week.
purpose.ar: حتى لا يبقى سؤال دون إجابة لأسبوع.

inputs: Answers to the questions that recur
executionSteps: Check on the agreed schedule.
Answer from the agreed answer list.
Escalate anything outside it rather than guessing.
Hide or report abuse to the agreed rule.
qualityChecks: No message older than the agreed window
Nothing answered outside the agreed answer list
Complaints escalated the same day
features.completionCriteria: The month closes with no message outside the response window.

description.en: Monitoring, plus starting conversations, handling complaints and growing the audience deliberately.
description.ar: المتابعة، مع بدء المحادثات ومعالجة الشكاوى وتنمية الجمهور عن قصد.

purpose.en: The difference between answering and being present.
purpose.ar: الفرق بين الرد وبين الحضور.

inputs: An escalation path with a named person on the client's side
executionSteps: Everything in monitoring.
Engage with the accounts worth engaging with, deliberately, not by volume.
Handle complaints in public briefly and in private fully.
Report anything that looks like a pattern rather than an incident.
qualityChecks: No complaint left in public without a reply
Escalations reached a named person, not an inbox
No engagement bought or automated
features.completionCriteria: The month closes with every complaint resolved or handed over with a named owner.

description.en: Finding the tags and search terms your audience actually uses, and refreshing them as they change.
description.ar: إيجاد الوسوم والكلمات التي يستخدمها جمهورك فعلًا، وتحديثها مع تغيّرها.

purpose.en: How people who do not follow you find you.
purpose.ar: الطريقة التي يجدك بها من لا يتابعك.

_comment: DEPTH, NOT A SECOND FEATURE. The owner's instruction on 8 September was
explicit: where the underlying capability is shared, keep ONE canonical
feature and differentiate it by scope. Content strategy at Growth and at
Pro is the same work done to a different depth, and publishing it twice
would give an automation two ids for one thing.
`priceFactor` multiplies pricing.from; `effortFactor` multiplies
estimatedEffort. A package row selects a level with `tier`; the builder
offers the levels as a choice on the row rather than as two rows.

description.en: Tag sets by size band, refreshed each month.
description.ar: مجموعات وسوم مصنّفة حسب الحجم، تُحدَّث شهريًا.

description.en: Tag sets plus the search terms your audience actually types, in every language they search in.
description.ar: مجموعات الوسوم مع الكلمات التي يبحث بها جمهورك فعلًا، بكل لغة يستخدمها.

scope: Retirement of terms that stopped working

inputs: The languages the audience searches in
executionSteps: Research in every language the audience actually searches in, Arabic included.
Build sets by size band rather than one list of the largest tags.
Check each set against the platform's own current behaviour, not last year's advice.
Retire tags that stopped working.
deliverables: Sets grouped by size band, per language
qualityChecks: Every tag checked as currently live and not restricted
Arabic terms researched natively, not translated
No set left unchanged for more than a quarter
features.completionCriteria: Sets delivered and applied to the month's calendar.

features._sharesMethodWith: The same method as feat.marketing.audience_research, applied to a different channel: one reads an organic audience, the other reads who responds to paid advertising. They stay two features because they sit in two services, two pipelines and two sets of deliverables — but an agent holding findings from either should reuse them, which is what this field is for.

description.en: Who your audience actually is, what the accounts around you are doing, and where the room to grow is.
description.ar: من هو جمهورك فعلًا، وما الذي تفعله الحسابات المحيطة بك، وأين مساحة النمو.

purpose.en: The assumption about the audience is usually the expensive one.
purpose.ar: الافتراض حول الجمهور هو الأكثر كلفة عادةً.

inputs: Whatever the client knows from selling to these people
executionSteps: Read the account’s own history before looking anywhere else.
Read the accounts around it — what they publish, what earns a reply, what they never touch.
Write the findings as differences from what the client believes, because that is the useful half.
Name the segments worth speaking to differently, in priority order.
deliverables: Segments with a stated reason each
qualityChecks: Every finding traceable to something we can point at, not to an impression
The client’s own assumption stated and either confirmed or contradicted explicitly
Arabic-language audiences researched in Arabic, not through translation
features.completionCriteria: Findings delivered and at least one segment from them carried into the next content plan.

description.en: What was published, what it did, and what we are changing because of it.
description.ar: ما نُشر، وما الذي حققه، وما الذي سنغيّره بناءً عليه.

purpose.en: So the spend is judged on a number rather than a feeling.
purpose.ar: حتى يُحكم على الإنفاق برقم لا بانطباع.

inputs: A complete calendar month of published activity
executionSteps: Pull the numbers from the platforms themselves.
Compare against the previous month and against the stated target, not against nothing.
Name the best and worst performing post and say why, in one line each.
End with what changes next month — a report with no decision in it is a receipt.
qualityChecks: Every figure traceable to a platform screen
No metric included that nobody will act on
At least one decision stated for next month
Sent within the agreed number of days after month end
features.completionCriteria: Report sent and next month's plan carries at least one decision from it.

description.en: What is actually growing — reach, followers, saves, messages — and which posts caused it.
description.ar: ما الذي ينمو فعلًا — الوصول والمتابعون والحفظ والرسائل — وأي المنشورات سببت ذلك.

purpose.en: A report says what happened. This says what to do more of.
purpose.ar: التقرير يقول ما حدث. وهذا يقول بماذا تستمر.

inputs: The previous month’s analysis, from month two
executionSteps: Track the movement over months, not the month in isolation — one month is weather.
Attribute the movement to specific posts, and say when it cannot be attributed.
Separate growth that was bought or borrowed (a collaboration, an ad) from growth the content earned.
End with the pattern worth repeating and the one worth stopping.
deliverables: Growth analysis appended to the monthly report
qualityChecks: Every figure traceable to a platform screen
Paid and organic growth reported apart
No trend claimed on a single month of data
At least one thing named to stop doing
features.completionCriteria: Analysis delivered with one repeat and one stop named.

description.en: Changing what we publish, and when, on the evidence the last month produced.
description.ar: تغيير ما ننشره ومتى ننشره، بناءً على ما أثبته الشهر الماضي.

purpose.en: A plan that never changes is a plan that stopped reading its own results.
purpose.ar: الخطة التي لا تتغير هي خطة توقفت عن قراءة نتائجها.

executionSteps: Change one thing at a time — format, hook, posting time or length — never several at once.
Give the change a full cycle before reading it.
Record the figure that justified the change and the figure that would reverse it.
Feed what survives back into the next calendar rather than into a document nobody opens.
outputs: A changed plan with the evidence behind it
deliverables: A change log with a before and after figure per change
qualityChecks: One variable per change
No change read before a full cycle
Every change carried into the next calendar or explicitly reversed
features.completionCriteria: The month closes with each change recorded and either kept or reversed on evidence.

description.en: A call to go through the report together and decide the next month.
description.ar: مكالمة لمراجعة التقرير معًا وتحديد خطة الشهر التالي.

purpose.en: Because a report nobody discusses changes nothing.
purpose.ar: لأن تقريرًا لا يُناقش لا يغيّر شيئًا.

inputs: The client's own view of what happened in the business
executionSteps: Send the report before the call, not during it.
Open with the decision to be made, not with the numbers.
Write down what was agreed and send it the same day.
outputs: Agreed decisions for the coming month
deliverables: A written note of what was agreed
qualityChecks: Report sent at least a day before
Every decision written down with an owner
Note sent the same day
features.completionCriteria: Decisions written, sent, and reflected in the next calendar.

description.en: We check the name, register it and configure it — in your name, on your account.
description.ar: نتحقق من الاسم ونسجّله ونضبط إعداداته — باسمك وعلى حسابك.

purpose.en: So the address belongs to you, not to your agency.
purpose.ar: حتى يكون العنوان ملكك أنت، لا ملك الوكالة.

note.en: The registrar's yearly fee is paid by you, to the registrar.
note.ar: الرسوم السنوية للمُسجِّل تدفعها أنت مباشرة للمُسجِّل.

inputs: The legal entity or person the domain is registered to
executionSteps: Check availability across the preferred names and the extensions worth holding.
Register in the client's name, on an account the client controls.
Configure DNS and enable auto-renew.
Record the expiry date and who holds the account.
outputs: A registered domain under the client's control
qualityChecks: Registrant is the client, not us
Auto-renew is on
WHOIS privacy set as the client chose
Expiry recorded somewhere a person will see it before it happens
features.completionCriteria: Domain resolves and the client can log in to the registrar account themselves.

revisionRules.scope: A different name is a new registration and a new fee.

description.en: We choose, provision and configure the hosting the site needs, with TLS.
description.ar: نختار الاستضافة المناسبة ونجهّزها ونضبطها، مع شهادة تشفير.

purpose.en: So the site is somewhere it will stay up.
purpose.ar: حتى يكون الموقع في مكان يبقى فيه يعمل.

note.en: The host's fee is paid by you, to the host.
note.ar: رسوم الاستضافة تدفعها أنت مباشرة لمزوّد الاستضافة.

inputs: Whether the site is static or needs a server
executionSteps: Choose a host that matches what the site actually is, not the largest plan available.
Provision on an account the client controls.
Point the domain, issue TLS and force HTTPS.
Set up backups and record where they go.
outputs: Provisioned hosting under the client's control
qualityChecks: HTTPS forced, HTTP redirects
Certificate auto-renews
A backup has been taken and restored once, not merely configured
Account owner is the client
features.completionCriteria: Site reachable over HTTPS on the client's domain and the client can log in to the host.

revisionRules.scope: A migration to a different host is quoted separately.

description.en: Every page designed at desktop and phone widths before anything is built.
description.ar: تصميم كل صفحة بعرض سطح المكتب والهاتف قبل بدء التنفيذ.

purpose.en: So the argument about the layout happens in a design, not in code.
purpose.ar: حتى يحدث النقاش حول التخطيط في التصميم لا في الكود.

inputs: Brand assets, ours or the client's
Real content, or a realistic stand-in for it
executionSteps: Design the phone width first, because it is the one that has to give something up.
Design every page in scope, not a representative one.
Define the states nobody remembers: empty, loading, error, long text, no image.
Specify type, spacing and colour as tokens, not as pixel values on a page.
outputs: Approved designs for every page in scope
deliverables: Design file with desktop and phone widths
qualityChecks: Every page designed at both widths
Text contrast checked, not eyeballed
Arabic layout designed right-to-left where the site is bilingual
Every interactive element has a visible focus state in the design
features.completionCriteria: Client has approved the designs at both widths in writing.

revisionRules.scope: Revision of the approved direction. A new direction restarts the stage and is quoted.

description.en: The approved design, built as a working site.
description.ar: تنفيذ التصميم المعتمد كموقع يعمل.

purpose.en: The part that turns a picture into something people can use.
purpose.ar: الجزء الذي يحوّل الصورة إلى شيء يستخدمه الناس.

inputs: Any third-party keys the site needs
executionSteps: Build semantic markup first, then style it.
Build every page in the approved design, and every state defined with it.
Optimise images at build time rather than shipping what was supplied.
Keep it working with JavaScript off wherever the page is content rather than an application.
outputs: A working site on a staging address
qualityChecks: Matches the approved design at both widths
No console errors on any page
Every image sized and given dimensions so nothing shifts as it loads
Headings form a real outline
features.completionCriteria: Every page in scope built and reviewable on staging.
