description.en: The site working at phone, tablet and desktop widths — not shrunk, laid out.
description.ar: الموقع يعمل بعرض الهاتف واللوحي وسطح المكتب — بتخطيط حقيقي لا بتصغير.

purpose.en: Most of your visitors are holding a phone.
purpose.ar: معظم زوارك يحملون هاتفًا.

executionSteps: Build fluid layouts rather than fixed breakpoints wherever the content allows.
Check every page at 320, 375, 414, 768, 1024 and 1280.
Check the same widths in the second language where the site is bilingual.
outputs: A site that holds at every tested width
deliverables: The same site — this is a property of it, not a separate file
qualityChecks: No horizontal scrollbar at 320px on any page
No tap target under 44px
Nothing clipped or overlapping at any tested width, in either language
features.completionCriteria: Every page passes at every tested width, in every language in scope.

description.en: Analytics, search-console verification, sitemap, metadata and the share cards.
description.ar: التحليلات وتوثيق أدوات البحث وخريطة الموقع وبيانات الوصف وبطاقات المشاركة.

purpose.en: The work nobody sees that decides whether anybody finds the site.
purpose.ar: العمل الذي لا يراه أحد ويحدد ما إذا كان أحد سيجد الموقع.

inputs: Analytics account, ours to create or the client's
executionSteps: Write a title and description for every page — never one for all of them.
Add structured data where the content genuinely fits a type.
Generate a sitemap and a robots file.
Install analytics and confirm a real event arrives.
Produce the share card and check it in the platforms' own preview tools.
qualityChecks: Every page has its own title and description
Sitemap lists every page and no page that does not exist
A test pageview appears in analytics
Share card renders in at least two platforms' preview tools
features.completionCriteria: Analytics receiving, search console verified, sitemap submitted.

description.en: Forms, booking, payment, mapping, chat or whatever the site has to talk to.
description.ar: النماذج أو الحجز أو الدفع أو الخرائط أو المحادثة أو ما يحتاج الموقع للاتصال به.

purpose.en: The difference between a brochure and something that does work for you.
purpose.ar: الفرق بين موقع تعريفي وموقع ينجز لك عملًا.

inputs: The list of services to integrate
What should happen when one of them fails
executionSteps: Confirm each service is one the client already pays for, or agree who will.
Integrate one at a time and test each end to end before starting the next.
Handle the failure path explicitly — a form that silently loses a message is worse than no form.
Keep keys out of the source.
deliverables: A note of what each does and who owns the account
qualityChecks: Each integration tested end to end, with the result seen at the other end
Failure path produces a message the visitor can act on
No key committed to the source
Nothing loads a third-party script that the page can work without
features.completionCriteria: Every integration in scope demonstrated working, including its failure path.

description.en: Every page, every width, every browser we support, and every form actually submitted.
description.ar: كل صفحة وكل عرض وكل متصفح مدعوم، مع إرسال كل نموذج فعليًا.

purpose.en: So the visitor is not the person who finds the bug.
purpose.ar: حتى لا يكون الزائر هو من يكتشف الخلل.

executionSteps: Walk every page at every supported width, in every language.
Submit every form and confirm the message arrives somewhere a person reads.
Follow every link, including the ones in the footer.
Run an accessibility check and read the results rather than the score.
Measure the largest page on a throttled connection.
deliverables: A written list of what was checked and what was found
qualityChecks: No broken link
Every form's message received and read
No accessibility violation left unexplained
No console error on any page
features.completionCriteria: Every check passed, or the exception written down and accepted by the client.

description.en: Putting the tested site live on your own domain.
description.ar: نشر الموقع المُختبَر على نطاقك الخاص.

purpose.en: The moment it stops being ours.
purpose.ar: اللحظة التي يتوقف فيها عن كونه لنا.

executionSteps: Deploy, then re-check the live site rather than trusting the deploy.
Confirm HTTPS, the sitemap and analytics on the live address.
Keep the previous state recoverable until the client has confirmed.
qualityChecks: Live site re-checked page by page, not assumed identical to staging
HTTPS forced on the live address
A rollback is possible and has been identified before deploying
features.completionCriteria: Live site verified by us and confirmed by the client.

description.en: Accounts, credentials and a short written guide to running it.
description.ar: الحسابات وبيانات الدخول ودليل مختصر لتشغيله.

purpose.en: So you can run it, change it or take it elsewhere.
purpose.ar: حتى تتمكن من تشغيله أو تعديله أو نقله إلى جهة أخرى.

inputs: Every account created during the project
executionSteps: Transfer every account to the client's ownership.
Hand over credentials through something that is not email.
Write a short guide covering the three things they will actually need to do.
Remove our own standing access unless the client asks us to keep it.
outputs: A client who owns and can operate the site
qualityChecks: Every account owned by the client
Client has logged in to each one at least once
Guide written for someone who was not in the project
features.completionCriteria: Client confirms in writing that they hold every account and can log in.

description.en: One more page, designed and built to match the rest of the site.
description.ar: صفحة إضافية، تُصمَّم وتُنفَّذ لتطابق بقية الموقع.

purpose.en: For the page the scope did not know about.
purpose.ar: للصفحة التي لم يكن النطاق يعلم بها.

features._addonName: THE PUBLISHED ADD-ON WORDING, kept exactly as it shipped. An add-on names the UNIT YOU BUY, which is not always the capability's own name — you buy 'a single social media post design', the capability is 'social media post design'. Preserving these verbatim is also what makes this change provably display-neutral: the generated add-ons section is byte-for-byte the hand-typed one it replaces, except for the single defect it fixes.
executionSteps: Design the page from the site's existing system rather than as a one-off.
Build it.
Add it to the navigation and the sitemap.
qualityChecks: Indistinguishable in style from the pages around it
Present in the sitemap and the navigation
Checked at every supported width
features.completionCriteria: Page live and reachable from the navigation.

description.en: The page designed to one action — layout, visual design, every width, and a design review before anything is built.
description.ar: تصميم الصفحة حول إجراء واحد — التخطيط والتصميم البصري وكل العروض، مع مراجعة تصميمية قبل بدء التنفيذ.

purpose.en: A campaign page argues for one thing. That argument is made in the design.
purpose.ar: صفحة الحملة تدافع عن شيء واحد. وهذا الدفاع يُصنع في التصميم.

inputs: The single action the page exists to produce
Brand assets, ours or the client’s
executionSteps: Agree the single action in one sentence before drawing anything.
Design the phone width first, because it is the one that has to give something up.
Design the states nobody remembers: submitted, failed, sold out, long copy, no image.
Review the design against the one action and cut whatever does not serve it.
outputs: Approved design at every supported width
deliverables: Design file with desktop and phone widths
qualityChecks: Exactly one primary action in the design
Text contrast measured, not eyeballed
Arabic laid out right-to-left where the page is bilingual
Every interactive element has a visible focus state in the design
features.completionCriteria: Client has approved the design at both widths in writing.

revisionRules.scope: Revision of the approved direction. A new direction restarts the concept stage and is quoted.

quoteReason.en: The published price is for a complete landing page. A single part on its own is scoped and quoted.
quoteReason.ar: السعر المنشور يشمل صفحة الهبوط كاملة. أما جزء واحد بمفرده فيُحدَّد نطاقه ويُسعَّر على حدة.

description.en: The approved design built as a working page — responsive, integrated with whatever it has to talk to, and tested.
description.ar: تنفيذ التصميم المعتمد كصفحة تعمل — متجاوبة ومتكاملة مع ما تحتاج الاتصال به ومُختبَرة.

purpose.en: The part that turns a picture into something a visitor can act in.
purpose.ar: الجزء الذي يحوّل الصورة إلى شيء يتفاعل معه الزائر.

inputs: Keys for anything it integrates with
A destination for whatever the form produces
executionSteps: Build semantic markup first, then style it.
Build every state the design defined, including the failure path.
Wire the form to somewhere a person actually reads, and prove a message arrives.
Check it at 320, 375, 414, 768, 1024 and 1280, in every language in scope.
outputs: A working page on a staging address
qualityChecks: Matches the approved design at every supported width
No console error
The form’s message received and read by a person, not merely submitted
The failure path produces something the visitor can act on
Loads in under two seconds on a throttled connection
features.completionCriteria: Page built, reviewable on staging, with its form proven end to end.

revisionRules.scope: Build corrections are not revisions. Design changes after approval are quoted.

quoteReason.en: The published price is for a complete landing page. A single part on its own is scoped and quoted.
quoteReason.ar: السعر المنشور يشمل صفحة الهبوط كاملة. أما جزء واحد بمفرده فيُحدَّد نطاقه ويُسعَّر على حدة.

description.en: Hosting, the address it lives at, going live, and checking the live page rather than the one we deployed.
description.ar: الاستضافة والعنوان الذي تعيش عليه، والنشر، وفحص الصفحة الحية لا التي نشرناها.

purpose.en: A campaign cannot start until the page it points at exists.
purpose.ar: لا تبدأ الحملة قبل أن توجد الصفحة التي تشير إليها.

inputs: A domain or subdomain, and who holds the account
executionSteps: Provision or reuse hosting, in the client’s name.
Point the domain or subdomain and force HTTPS.
Deploy, then walk the live page rather than trusting the deploy.
Confirm the conversion fires on the live address, not on staging.

features._composedOf: THE PUBLISHED PRICE BUYS THE WHOLE PAGE, and this is what the whole page is made of. The three parts have different workflows, different dependencies, different deliverables and different automation potential — deployment is `full`, design is `assist` — so they are three features. A client may take design alone; that is a scope the studio has never published a price for, so each part alone is quoted. Selecting design does NOT bring development or deployment with it: the dependency runs the other way.
